UPSTREAM: drm/amdgpu: Add debugfs file for VBIOS and version Add 2 debugfs files, one that contains the VBIOS version, and one that contains the VBIOS itself. These won't change after initialization, so we can add the VBIOS version when we parse the atombios information. This ensures that we can find out the VBIOS version, even when the dmesg buffer fills up, and makes it easier to associate which VBIOS version is for which GPU on mGPU configurations. Set the size to 20 characters in case of some weird VBIOS version that exceeds the expected 17 character format (3-8-3\0). The VBIOS dump also allows for easy debugging v2: Move to debugfs, clarify commit message, add VBIOS dump file BUG=b:65489307 TEST=boot Kahlee, run graphics_SanAngeles Signed-off-by: Kent Russell <kent.russell@amd.com> Reviewed-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com> Reviewed-by: Christian Knig <christian.koenig@amd.com> Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com> (cherry picked from commit db95e2185523ee9d46a13ceee37bffe8442d2e1c) Signed-off-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@chromium.org> Change-Id: Ib1c88190c5792a48c8930100ce7a44315ed07c0a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/799090 Commit-Ready: Dominik Behr <dbehr@google.com> Tested-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@google.com> Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>
